text.p: MobileMedia Corp., the nation's second-largest provider of paging service, said Tuesday it may seek Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection if it fails to negotiate new payment terms with its creditors.
The company warned of the possible bankruptcy filing after announcing that it did not make a scheduled $5.6 million interest payment in an effort to conserve cash.
MobileMedia said it is also seeking to modify payment terms with some of its vendors, including Motorola Inc., its largest supplier of paging equipment and parts, which is owed $34 million.
MobileMedia provides paging and personal communications services to 4.5 million subscribers in the United States, Canada and the Caribbean.
